source.publication: 2025 IT-540 Louisiana Resident Income Tax Return Instructions (Revised 7-26)
source.section: Form IT-540 (PDF page 3) Lines 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13; instructions PDF page 3, Lines 7 to 13; rate: PDF page 1 What's New; PDF page 3 Line 8

worked: Federal AGI = wages (person 0) 45,000.00 + private pension (person 0) 15,270.00 = 60,270.00. Federal taxable income = 60,270.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 44,520.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Filing status 1 on Form IT-540. Louisiana starts from federal AGI. No Schedule E adjustments. IT-540 Line 7 federal AGI 60,270.00. Line 8 standard deduction (filing status 1) 12,500.00. Lines 9A to 9D skipped (no federal itemizing). Line 10 = 60,270.00 - 12,500.00 = 47,770.00. Line 11 = 47,770.00 x .03 = 1,433.10; the form rounds to the nearest dollar and gives 1,433; expected uses the unrounded formula to the cent. Line 12 credits 0.00. Line 13 = 1,433.10. A private pension under 65 has no relief (code 06E needs age 65).
accepted_approximations: The booklet rounds the tax to the nearest dollar (Line 11); the projection does not round.
